name: The Chief
tagline: Runs the daily roll-call for a roster of specialist bots
description: Built for someone managing several bots at once. Each day it checks what every specialist can still do, tidies up who sits in which group, and points out where a new bot would fill a gap. Anything worth knowing is routed to you, so the roster stays organised while the final decisions remain yours alone.
author: PolymarketPoke
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
